attchmntText: Cantabil Retail India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Cantabil Retail India Limited announced un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations grew by 11% to 370.5 crores rupees. EBITDA increased by 14% to 103.8 crores rupees with a margin of 28.0%. Profit after tax rose by 9% to 23.4 crores rupees. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations grew by 9% to 191.7 crores rupees. EBITDA grew by 5% to 44.4 crores rupees with a margin of 23.2%. Profit after tax increased by 4% to 7.0 crores rupees. The company operates 690 exclusive brand outlets.

attchmntText: Cantabil Retail India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Cantabil Retail India Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue of Rs. 191.7 Crs for Q2 FY27, showing 9% year-on-year growth. Profit after tax was Rs. 7.0 Crs, up 4%. For H1 FY27, revenue reached Rs. 370.5 Crs, an 11% increase, with profit after tax at Rs. 23.4 Crs, up 9%. The company added 23 net stores in Q2, bringing the total count to 690. Total retail area stood at 9.89 lakh sq. ft. Average selling price was Rs. 859 in Q2. Volume growth was 6.02% for the quarter.

attchmntText: Cantabil Retail India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Cantabil Retail India Limited approved standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, at its Board meeting on November 13, 2026. Statutory auditors Walker Chandiok & Co LLP issued a limited review report. The company declared a final dividend of Rs. 0.75 per equity share for the year ended March 31, 2026. Lease term estimates were reassessed, decreasing lease liabilities by Rs. 123,361.29 lakhs and right-of-use assets by Rs. 23,621.80 lakhs, increasing profit after tax by Rs. 485.43 lakhs. The Board also considered the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow for the period.

attchmntText: Cantabil Retail India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Cantabil Retail India Limited has intimated a conference call for investors and analysts regarding the financial and operating performance for Q2 and H1 FY27. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 05:15 PM IST. The session will be represented by Chairman and Managing Director Vijay Bansal, Wholetime Directors Deepak Bansal and Basant Goyal, CFO Shivendra Nigam, and Company Secretary Poonam Chahal. Registration details and dial-in numbers for various regions including India, Singapore, Hong Kong, UK, and USA are provided in the attached invite. The company filed this notice pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.
